name: Knott's Boardwalk BBQ Smoked Tri-Tip Sirloin or Ribs with Creamy Mac & Cheese
brandOrRestaurant: Boardwalk BBQ (The Boardwalk · Knott's Berry Farm)
searchKeywords: boardwalk bbq mac and cheese knotts
whyItWorks: Tender carved tri-tip sirloin paired with Boardwalk BBQ's smooth baked cavatappi mac & cheese (or mashed potatoes) gives you a high-calorie, low-residue meal.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Smoked Tri-Tip with Mashed Potatoes or Mac & Cheese (take lactase for the cheese sauce) and skip the spicy Jalapeño Cheddar Sausage and coleslaw.
watchOuts: Avoid the spicy Jalapeño Cheddar Sausage and raw cabbage slaw
